messages:
Maria (CS): Hey team — quick week0 check on AnchorPoint's private deploy. They flagged telemetry retention + KMS rotation as potential renewal blockers. Looking for status on network, IAM, and audit logs. /cc @Leo (NetOps) @Anika (Infra Eng) :eyes:
Sam (Customer): Thx Maria. We're worried retention is only 7d by default. Need 30d for compliance. Also want KMS auto-rotate timeline and who has access to key. Not blocking cutover but renewal concern.
Leo (NetOps): We're waiting on the customer's NAT/proxy CIDR for egress. Firewall rules drafted. Asked them for 10.0.8.0/24. Once they confirm I'll update SGs and route tables. :+1:
Anika (Infra Eng): IAM roles: drafted least-priv policy for redwood-service-role. Will push to their account for review. Also proposing S3 bucket ARN pattern: arn:aws:s3:::anchorpoint-logs-*. Suggesting SSE-KMS with key alias arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:alias/anchorpoint-root
Jamie (SEA): Renewal risk note — usage ramp is 35% below projection; if telemetry retention can't be extended we'll flag it as a "compliance impact" in renewal QA. Can we prioritize the 30d retention patch?
Leo (NetOps): If they approve 10.0.8.0/24 I can schedule a quick window tomorrow 02:00-03:00 UTC to update NAT GW and SGs. Any objections?
Sam (Customer): Confirmed 10.0.8.0/24. Also, rotation: prefer 90-day rotation cadence. Who owns rotation ops? We need a rotation playbook.
Anika (Infra Eng): We can automate rotation via KMS schedule + runbook. I'll drop a sample runbook snippet:
```
# rotate_kms_key.sh
aws kms schedule-key-deletion --key-id <key-id> --pending-window-in-days 7
# rotate by creating new key, re-encrypt, update alias
```
I'll attach full runbook to the handoff doc.
AuditBot: Log sample: [INFO] delivery: s3://anchorpoint-logs/2026/03/22/ingest.log size=12MB status=OK
Maria (CS): Action items:
- Anika: finalize KMS rotation runbook + share doc link
- Leo: implement SG/NAT changes in maintenance window
- Jamie: update renewal risk tracker with 'telemetry retention' and 'ramp shortfall'
- Sam: confirm any higher retention SLAs for contract
Can we sync 30m tomorrow 09:00 PT? :calendar:
Sam (Customer): 09:00 PT works. Thx all.
Jamie (SEA): I'll update tracker and send calendar invite after Maria confirms.
Maria (CS): Confirmed. Added meeting — invite sent. Please upload any pre-read to Confluence under /customer-success/anchorpoint/privnet-retention
Leo (NetOps): On it. I'll post SG diffs in thread after window is scheduled.
Anika (Infra Eng): Will share runbook by EOD.
Maria (CS): Great — closing thread for now. Ping if anything blocks :white_check_mark:
